## Experience
- **Independent Consultant, Delivery & Technical Advisory** · Freelance · Jan 2025 – Present. Advising on .NET projects (performance bottlenecks, which architectural changes are worth paying for); hands-on with Azure and current AI development tooling (Cursor, Claude Code, Gemini, Copilot).
- **Software Development Coordinator (Delivery Manager & Scrum Master)** · LSEG · Oct 2023 – Dec 2024. A release every three weeks for a global team of 15 to 20 with no rollbacks; owned change management through GitHub pipelines and ServiceNow approvals; moved the .NET workload from AWS to Azure without taking production down; Scrum Master; designed and ran hiring interviews for analysts, testers and developers.
- **Lead .NET Developer** · LSEG · Jul 2022 – Oct 2023. Built the ListAPI module of a Portfolio Management platform and shipped it on time (Clean Architecture, CQRS); coordinated the local developers.
- **Software Developer** · Qualysoft · Oct 2020 – Jun 2022. Coordinated the implementation of one module of a GPS tracking solution; supported the team on implementation and delivery processes.
- **Software Development Team Coordinator** · Yokogawa · Jan 2019 – Apr 2020. Started the software team from nothing (role profiles, hiring, Azure DevOps, CI/CD); introduced Agile to stakeholders; requirements, user stories, sprint planning, status reporting.
- **Software Engineer** · ORTEC · Mar 2018 – Sep 2018. C#/ASP.NET integration on Exact Synergy; functional specifications.
- **Lead Software Developer** · Yokogawa · Aug 2011 – Jun 2017. Agreed cross-company data-transfer standards with Siemens, WAGO and ABB (the target was 80% less effort to migrate an industrial automation project between platforms); ran Yokogawa's booth and workshops at the NAMUR Global Assembly 2016 (500+ attendees); NAMUR Modular Production prototype integrated into Centum VP; business analysis in Japan, the Netherlands and Germany; code reviews, QA procedures, mentoring.
